scope.heading: 1. Which products
scope.help: Pick a type, then check the photos — you should recognize each item.

intro.heading: Before you advertise, run a feed check
intro.body: We do not promise Google approval. We first turn titles, color/size, the no-barcode path, and main images into a shopping-ready feed so you can see what changed, then hand the link to Merchant Center. We never invent barcodes or COGS — add real ones below if you have them.
intro.note: After submit, Google often shows Limited / Pending initial review. That is the first-review queue (a few business days), not an App failure.

pipeline.heading: Generating
pipeline.doneHint: Fix color or size on the products listed under To fix.
pipeline.stay: Stay on this page. When finished we mark color/size changes so you can fix them in one click.

title.label: Title
title.copy: Turning supplier-style titles into Google Shopping structure…

variant.label: Color / size
variant.copy: Checking each color and size; gaps get a smart fill you can edit…

id.label: Barcode / no-ID path
id.copy: No real barcode → open the no-ID path (no fake codes). Add UPC/EAN on Shopify variants if you have them…

image.label: Ad image
image.copy: Checking if the main image looks like wholesale stock so you can swap a clean store photo…

billing.approveHint: Tap Approve charge in Shopify, then come back here.

plans.pageIntro: Compare Free, Starter, and Growth. Pick a paid plan to continue in Shopify checkout.
plans.howQuota: Quota = parent products × ad platforms × markets (not variants). One product with 5 colors × 5 sizes still counts as 1 unit for Google + US.

free.name: Free
free.blurb: Try the flow on a small catalog.

starter.name: Starter
starter.blurb: For shops running Google Shopping regularly.

brand.heading: Ad brand (written to feed)
brand.help: This is the store-wide brand written to every feed item (g:brand). Shopify product Vendor is often a supplier name (e.g. eprolo) — we do not copy it automatically. Confirm once; only tap again if you change it.
brand.warn: Ad brand not confirmed. Enter it and tap Confirm brand, or feed generation stays blocked (avoids Missing brand disapprovals).
brand.label: Ad brand
brand.placeholder: e.g. your store name or own brand

merchantData.heading: Barcode & cost (optional)
merchantData.help: Does not block feed generation. We never invent barcodes or COGS; real data improves matching and profit reports.
merchantData.gtinBody: No barcode is fine: we use the no-ID path and keep the ad brand above. If packaging has a real UPC/EAN, add it under Shopify → product → variant Barcode; the next generate writes g:gtin. Leave blank if you have no real code — do not invent digits.
merchantData.cogsBody: Not required for free listings. If you know true cost, set Shopify variant Cost for profit reports later; otherwise leave blank — do not invent estimates.

compliance.heading: Is the site ready for ads?
compliance.help: Checks policy pages, footer links, HTTPS, and selected-market currency. Google looks at these too; this does not block feed generation.
compliance.allPass: No open store issues for this check.
compliance.needRun: Tap Run check to scan policies, footer links, and HTTPS.
compliance.currencyOk: Selected market currency matches the store (or is usable)

currency.mismatchBanner: Selected {{markets}}; store currency is {{shop}}. Align Shopify presentment currency before generating (App only detects — no auto FX).
currency.fixHint: In Shopify, set presentment currency to match the selected market, then generate again.

quality.heading: What to do next
quality.bodyGreen: Required fields look complete. Next: copy the feed link below into Google Merchant Center. Approval is still Google’s call; new stores often wait a few days for initial review.
quality.bodyYellow: Auto-fixed {{auto}} items (e.g. color/size fallbacks, no-barcode path). {{warn}} items need a spot-check. Missing barcode or COGS is not a disapproval reason; add real values in Shopify if you have them. This is not “approved” — it means “ok to submit, look first.”
quality.bodyRed: {{fatals}} high-risk items are still in the feed. Fix the red list below before treating this as ad-ready.
quality.missingVariantId: {{count}} variants lack a Shopify Variant ID, so links cannot target color/size. Re-sync products, then regenerate; do not advertise those SKUs until fixed (no internal fake IDs).
quality.titleCompareHelp: Left is the store title; right is the shopping-style ad title (brand + type + this-row color/size).
quality.confirmHeading: Needs your eye — fix in one go
quality.confirmHelp: We used Multicolor / One Size so Google isn’t blocked by empty fields. Select products, set the real color or size, apply once — regenerates the feed, no optimization quota.
quality.sensitiveHelp: Phrases softened or marked adult; update Shopify copy as suggested. FATAL items should not be advertised.
quality.imageHelp: Main image may be wholesale stock. Pick a clean photo from the Shopify gallery as the ad image (does not write back to Shopify).

checklist.shipping: Before uploading to Google, confirm shipping is configured in Merchant Center for the target country
checklist.claim: Confirm the website is claimed and product pages are publicly reachable
checklist.fatal: If red FATAL items remain, uploading is at your own disapproval risk

quality.bodyGreenShort: Looks submit-ready. Copy the link above into Merchant Center. Google’s review can take a few days.
quality.bodyYellowShort: Auto-fixed {{auto}} items. {{review}} need a real color/size or image — select them below and fix in one go (no quota).
quality.bulkHelp: Use Fix all variants for many rows. Tap Add size on one row to edit only that row.
quality.bulkHint: Tip: tap “Select all”, enter a real color or size, then Apply.

feeds.heading: Multilingual Google Shopping feed links
feeds.help: Copy into Google Merchant Center. Limited after submit is usually first-review queue.

targets.marketsHelp: Default US (USD). For each market, set Shopify presentment to that currency; mismatches are blocked.

images.heading: Pick an ad main image
images.help: Changes only the ad feed image, not your Shopify product page. “Recommended” is usually cleaner; “Not recommended” often means wholesale stock.
images.empty: No candidates found — upload product images in Shopify first.

products.heading: Select products for the feed ({{selected}}/{{total}}, {{variants}} variants)
products.help: This is the main step — check what goes into the feed.
products.needsInListHint: {{n}} products need fixes — pinned to the top.
products.fixThisHint: “Fix all variants” checks every SKU below, then fill color/size once above.

tags.noGtin: No-ID path (add real barcode in Shopify if you have one)

msg.needPlatformMarket: Select at least one platform and one market
msg.needBrand: Confirm an ad brand below first. Apparel Google needs brand; empty brand often fails as Missing brand.
msg.quotaShort: Not enough quota: need {{need}}, {{left}} left. Please upgrade.
msg.checking: Check in progress. We clean titles, fill color/size, and open the no-ID path.
msg.blockedOnly: Feed not generated: {{countries}} blocked for currency mismatch. Align Shopify presentment with the selected markets and retry.
msg.doneFatal: Check done: feed generated, but {{fatals}} high-risk items remain. Review the list below — not “approved” yet.
msg.doneWarn: Check done: auto-fixed {{auto}} items; {{warn}} still need a spot-check before Google.
msg.doneOk: Check done: fields look complete — add the feed link in Google Merchant Center.
msg.noFeed: Feed not generated: no writable country or products.
msg.brandEmpty: Enter an ad brand before confirming. Apparel Google needs brand.
msg.brandSaved: Ad brand saved as “{{brand}}”. Feed generate will write g:brand.
